_comment: Vendored governance profile for the injection-defense benchmark. This is the deny-by-default tool allowlist + Airlock RASP config a governed 'safe coding agent' would run under. BOTH the Rust real-RASP harness (rust/crates/fd-policy/tests/injection_defense.rs) and the fd-evals module (fd_evals.injection_defense) read this exact file, so the defense decision is measured against one config on both planes. Airlock runs in enforce mode for the measurement (a violation blocks). Velocity / schema-drift / behavioral-drift layers are disabled here because they are stateful or out-of-scope for a per-call indirect-injection measurement.
